description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for reading news articles. It includes a stateful widget that displays a web view of an article URL, integrates text-to-speech (TTS) functionality for reading the article aloud, and provides UI controls for playback, speed, and voice selection. Additionally, it supports sharing, saving, and browsing the article through a popup menu.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: Data class holding arguments for reading an article, specifically a NewsArticle instance.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: Main widget class representing the screen for reading a news article, including web view and TTS controls.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: State class for ReadArticleScreen, managing WebViewController, FlutterTts, playback controls, and UI interactions.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A stateless widget providing a popup menu for controlling TTS playback options like play, stop, speed, and voice.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Configures the FlutterTts instance with language and speech rate.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles the selected action from the 'More' popup menu: browsing, sharing, or saving the article.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text content to be read aloud, appending a message about paid version.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Starts TTS speaking the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Adjusts speech rate and restarts TTS playback.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS voice based on selected index and then plays the content.
